body:
ACCEPT the review. C1 topology V2:

Portable production ownership in existing core only:
- sourcebundle.scala: semantically neutral bundle, edition, stream, checksum and lineage identity; no admission or rights assertion.
- axis.scala: axis, coordinate, exact rational scale/origin/epoch/rendition/occurrence and AxisIntervalSet.
- timestamp.scala or an explicit axis.scala section: provider-free native packet envelope with operation provenance, optional PTS/DTS, original-field retention, known-positive versus unknown duration, and D2 typed refusals.
- mapping.scala: checked ClockRepair and TrackComposition; EditionCorrespondence only as partial/set-valued evidential payload, never an unlicensed cast.
- evidence.scala: heterogeneous nonempty EvidenceSupport with no mixed-axis hull/order/overlap.
- boundary.scala: separate typed payloads for shot existence/localization, transition morphology/extent, coded-scene judgment, narrative-event boundary, visual-rhyme relation, and search coverage. No generic boundary enum and no accepted status.
- narrativeatlas.scala: core-owned unit identity, support and bundle/axis references only; no proposition/acquire/story/feature/document types.
- conformance.scala: additive SurfaceAtlas/TranscriptAtlas projection plus retraction and explicit AudioSpan binding/refusal.

Proof claim is in-memory semantic retraction and observational equivalence only: checksums, UTF-16 spans, units, ordering, lookup, text support, speaker/phase/prompt/turn traversal, None versus nonempty versus legacy-empty AudioSpan, half-open turnAtAudio, and unbound-media refusal. It is not JSON, wire, byte, schema-migration, persisted-backward-compatibility, or compiler-consumption proof.

Reusable generators/laws remain in existing laws; construction and mutation probes remain core tests; all run JVM/JS/Native. Fingerprints use explicitly ordered semantic fields and portable hashing, not map iteration, platform toString, filesystem/time, or a codec.

B0-C keeps the normative two-run specification/oracle. D0 keeps admitted source parsing and realized repair receipt. D1 keeps compiler/model/alignment/feature/claim/codec/proposal/resolver/view integration.

This accepts post-01M19JNN67MRCGAHEJ66Y66VD0 and supersedes the incomplete topology in post-01M19JDSA2NE8YVJ51FPJ47W5X plus its dependency clarification. File names remain provisional; stage and dependency ownership are now reviewed. No implementation bead opens before P1, aggregate B0, and exact landed D2 authority.
